sys_script_include.description: Resolves the module execution plan for a submission from x_gegis_ins_policy_module_plan (flat matrix: one row per situation, one order column per module, 0 = do not create, equal numbers = parallel). Handles simple and advanced (scripted) plan modes, licence filtering, per-module restart (none/override/new_version), playbook cancel/restart/trigger via sn_playbook.PlaybookExperience, and cutting a new submission version per x_gegis_ins_policy_version_copy_rule. OrchestrationService delegates every plan decision here.
sys_script_include.name: ModulePlanService
